basis: Written from the identification-ceiling result (data/gold/identification_ceiling.md: levels 0.85 archetype, summary 0.57; calibration 0.58 from summary features, 0.17 from levels alone) and the definitions of the image state; committed before any v3 measurement. Version 2 signatures (characterisation_signatures_v2.*) are unchanged and re-evaluated.

classifiers.centroid: nearest centroid in the training fold's standardised space (the battery's)
classifiers.logistic: L2 multinomial logistic regression, penalty chosen by nested cross-validation inside every training fold (grid 0.0001 to 10 by decades, 4 inner folds, cross-validated log-loss), as in the identification ceiling

features.G: per coarse slice: red grain share = claimed red / (solid red + claimed red), 0 where both are 0
features.L: per coarse slice (sector and field rings): solid red, green and blue levels
features.S: the v2 summary features (BASE_FEATURES and the arc shares, the battery's identification names), passed through unreduced
features.T: per coarse slice: saturation of the solid layer (tier, LI.38)
features.reduction: PCA on the columns standardised with the training fold's mean and sd, top k components (k = 20), fitted inside every training fold and, for the penalty search, again inside every inner fold; unsupervised, labels never read; sign of each component fixed by its largest absolute loading being positive

sets.v3_k10: as v3 with k = 10 (exploratory, truth rows only)
sets.v3_k40: as v3 with k = 40 (exploratory, truth rows only)

protocol: leave one out per persona; reduction, scaling and tuning fitted on the training rows only; deterministic (no random numbers)

rule.diff: difference of accuracy a - b over the same personas, normal-approximation 95% interval of the paired difference of correct flags (persona-level means over the three variants for the extracted set, 40 clusters, Student-t 39 df); held if the difference >= delta and the interval excludes 0; not held if the interval's upper end < delta; else inconclusive. The exact sign test is reported (per persona-variant flags; for the extracted set on the persona-level sign of the mean difference)
rule.max: held if the point accuracy <= value, not held if the Wilson 95% lower bound > value, else inconclusive
rule.min: held if the point accuracy >= value, not held if the Wilson 95% upper bound < value, else inconclusive
rule.multiplicity: no adjustment; each prediction is read on its own, with its stated confidence; the report counts held against the confidences' expectation
rule.rank_low: held if any named class is among the k lowest-recall classes (ties by class order)

sets.extracted: starter extracted (var0, var1, var2) / new: the 40 starter personas, rows read from resume texts, new projection; each variant evaluated on its own (leave one out within the variant) and pooled, 120 persona-variants
sets.legacy: extended / legacy: the same 144 personas under the legacy projection
sets.truth: extended / new: 144 generated personas (8 archetypes x 3 calibrations x 6), truth rows, fine evidence, new projection

smallest_effects: each prediction's delta or value is the smallest effect that matters; directions are stated in the text
